description: This file defines a client interface and its implementation for managing polled client connections within an operator or device management context. It includes structures and methods for handling message sending, connection management, and disconnection handling, specifically for a polled connection model.

classes.name: PolledClient
classes.description: Represents a polled client connection to a device, handling message queuing and disconnection cleanup.

classes.name: PolledSet
classes.description: Manages multiple polled client connections, allowing creation, retrieval, and destruction of connections.

methods.name: Send
methods.description: Queues a message to be sent to the client.

methods.name: OnDeviceDisconnected
methods.description: Handles cleanup when the device disconnects.

methods.name: ToDevice
methods.description: Sends a message directly to the associated device.

methods.name: GetMessages
methods.description: Retrieves messages received from the device, with support for skipping initial messages.

methods.name: NewConnection
methods.description: Creates a new polled client connection for a device, generating a unique id.

methods.name: GetConnection
methods.description: Retrieves a connection by its id.

methods.name: Destroy
methods.description: Removes a connection from the set, cleaning up resources.
